summary: Healthy Choice Wellness Corp. (HCWC) filed an 8-K reporting shareholder votes at an August 27, 2026 special meeting approving the issuance of shares in connection with a merger under which HCWC will be acquired by Host Digital Infrastructure LLC (Host Digital). The proposal includes issuance of HCWC common stock as merger consideration, including pre-funded warrants at $0.0001 per share. Shareholders also approved increasing authorized common shares to 2 billion, a name change selected by Host Digital, and other charter amendments. Votes for the stock issuance totaled 19,801,784 for, 647,352 against. The merger appears structured as a reverse merger with Host Digital controlling the combined entity. Regulatory approval and closing conditions remain pending; watch for deal completion risks and any appraisal rights.
